summary: This bill directs the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to posthumously present a Congressional Gold Medal to the family of Lance Corporal Dustin Sekula in recognition of his heroic life, and authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to strike and sell bronze duplicates.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes the striking of a Congressional Gold Medal and duplicate bronze medals, with costs charged against the United States Mint Public Enterprise Fund. This represents a minor increase in government spending for a commemorative item.

The bill posthumously awards a Congressional Gold Medal to a Lance Corporal who died during Operation Iraqi Freedom, recognizing his heroic life and service. While not directly about military operations or defense spending, it honors a military member and acknowledges military service.
